Small, practical utilities for inspecting software behaviour, testing integrations and making development work a little easier.

Useful while building and debugging

This section collects developer-focused tools I have put together while working with APIs, applications and the wider cCoder platform. They are intended to provide a direct, uncomplicated way to inspect something, try an idea or answer a technical question without first setting up a larger project.

The tools may be useful for investigating an integration, understanding a request and response, or simply saving time during development. Browse the available utilities below and use whichever ones are helpful.
